cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says a law, decree or policy in force classifies government data or requires state data to be held in the country; the Central Bank's Circular 18 covers banks and payment firms.
cells.note: Reassessed under Bill's ruling of 2026-10-31 (messages-for-bill 60: a rule must include government or state data): Central Bank Circular 18 binds banks and payment firms, not state data (LBY-001). Cabinet Decision 358 of 2026 charges a new authority with classifying national data and regulating its hosting (LBY-002), so stage 2.
